name: Cribbage
tagline: Fifteen two, fifteen four, and one for his nobs.
howToPlay: Throw two cards into the crib — the dealer's extra hand — then play cards one at a time, calling the running total out loud. Fifteen scores two, thirty-one scores two, and pairs and runs score as you make them.
Then everyone counts the four cards they kept, plus the cut card, all over again. The non-dealer counts first, and that order is the whole game: at 118 apiece, whoever counts first wins.

variants.name: Once around (61)
variants.description: A match to 61 — once around the board instead of twice.

variants.name: No heels
variants.description: A jack turned as the starter scores the dealer nothing.
